{
  "score": 3,
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "critical",
      "line": 1866,
      "message": "The `iter > 0` guard is always true because `iter` starts at 1, so `stage.start` is now unconditionally emitted for every cycle member in every run—fresh and resumed—violating GUAR-1 (a fresh run must behave exactly as today); before this change cycle members never emitted `stage.start`, and the design doc (Gap 7) explicitly named this guard wrong.",
      "quote": "if [[ \"$iter\" -gt 0 ]]; then\n            eb_emit_event \"stage.start\" \"stage=$s\" \\",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "high",
      "line": 2436,
      "message": "The CMBR-1 skip guard is never activated when a run is interrupted during iter=1: `_persisted_iter` is 0 (the init value, since `_cycle_state_write_iter_atomic` writes `current_iter=N` only at the END of each iteration), so `_start_iter=1` and the `_start_iter > 1` condition is false; already-complete iter-1 members (e.g. 'build') are re-dispatched on resume instead of being skipped.",
      "quote": "if [[ \"$iter\" -eq \"$_start_iter\" && \"$_start_iter\" -gt 1 ]]; then\n            _cid_resume_first_iter=true\n        fi",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh",
      "category": "logic",
      "severity": "medium",
      "line": 1446,
      "message": "When CMBR-1 skips a complete member it issues a bare `continue` without adding that member's persisted verdict and status to `blob`; the predicate blob for the resumed iteration is therefore missing that member's entry, so any `exit_when`, `abort_when`, or `until` predicate that references the skipped member evaluates against an absent key and can neither converge nor abort correctly.",
      "quote": "if [[ \"$_cmbr_status\" == \"complete\" ]]; then\n                continue\n            fi",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "tests/integration/resume-loop-state-test.sh",
      "category": "coverage",
      "severity": "medium",
      "line": 51,
      "message": "The ITER-1 fixture writes `current_iter=2` by running 2 full rounds via `zb_engine_loop_state`, but in a real run interrupted during iter=2 `current_iter` would be 1 (written at the end of iter=1); the test therefore validates a state shape that never arises naturally, masking the fact that real interrupted-in-iter-2 state causes `_start_iter=1` and re-runs iter=1.",
      "quote": "zb_engine_loop_state \"$STATE_FILE\" \"build-test\" 2 5 \"in_progress\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "test"
    }
  ]
}
